citations.assessment: Rabbi Ila states that the righteous will live through rolling. Rabbi Abba Salla Rabba objects to the pain, and Abaye answers that passages are prepared. The received text has Abba for Heilprin’s Abay and does not portray the objector as transmitting Abaye.
This is the Abba/Salla notice referenced explicitly in the neighboring entry. Its separate Kafri genealogy does not resolve the identity of the Ketubot objector.

holds.reason: The opening report in Abaye’s name and the reported alternate form remain distinct. The accessible source shows an objection and subsequent answer, which does not establish a personal encounter.
